title: Storage status
description: storage.status's result (feature results, kind storage): the common status shape, plus where the member can connect and what their password waits on. Every valid reply is also a valid common/status.json reply. Read live, never stored.

places.description: Everywhere the account can connect, read from the folder permissions for the groups it is in, home folder first.

places_readable.description: false is 'the folder permissions could not be read', never 'no places'.

needs_password.description: The account has no password yet, so it cannot be used until the member sets one.

needs_new_password.description: Access was given back after it was taken away, and the account waits for a new password.

quota_read.description: Completeness, as in homes.json: true only when every share's usage was read. false means some or all of it could not be read, a partial read included, so a share may be missing from meters (or meters empty) for that reason and not because nothing is used; the meters present were read.
